title: products (native to page)
description: Plans known to Google Play, with the price formatted for the customer's locale. Plans missing from the list cannot be bought.

result.description: unavailable: Google Play billing cannot be used on this device.

basePlanId.description: Google Play base plan id, or null for the product's only base plan.

formattedPrice.description: ProductDetails formattedPrice of the base plan's regular pricing phase, e.g. "€4.99".

message.description: Developer-facing detail, never shown to the customer.
